title: KestrelCare Facility Agreement Schedule: Collection Share on Recoveries
content:
| Facility type on the decision the payment settled | Collection share on a KestrelCare recovery |
|---|---|
| independent licensed repair shop | 95 percent (the independent collection share) |
| franchised dealer | 98 percent (the franchise collection share) |
| Kestrel network facility | the whole amount |

**Term.** When a KestrelCare Vehicle Service Contracts claim payment made in error is recovered, a facility collection share applies, read from the facility type on the decision the payment settled: an independent licensed repair shop is charged the independent collection share, a franchised dealer the franchise collection share, and a Kestrel network facility the whole amount.

The facility type is the one shown on the claim decision entry the payment names as its source.

*Hypothetical:* on an amount of 1000.00 being recovered, an independent licensed repair shop is charged 950.00, a franchised dealer 980.00 and a Kestrel network facility 1000.00.
